title: Tomb Raider on the Nintendo Game Boy Advance is incredible | MVG
summary: Modern Vintage Gamer looks at OpenLara, an open source Tomb Raider engine, running on the Game Boy Advance. The video explains how the port achieves playable speeds on the GBA's slow ARM CPU, with input from the developer XProger.
why: HN points to it as coverage of an impressive 3D game port on very limited hardware.

quote.text: I found some fascinating coverage of the OpenLara project, specifically for the port of Tomb Raider to the GBA.
